title: Tsunami Response
description: Explains the natural warnings (a strong or long earthquake, the ocean draining or rising, a roar) that mean leave now, and NOAA's alert levels. Covers where to go, what to do if caught in water, a building, or a boat, and why to stay away until officials say it's safe.
shortDescription: Natural warnings, reaching high ground fast, and why later waves can be worse
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
